hook: Their sailboat went dark 44 miles out in the Gulf.
narration: Their sailboat lost all power at night, forty four miles out.
Four people were aboard, south of St. George Island, Florida.
A Jayhawk from Air Station Clearwater lowered its rescue swimmer into the dark.
A thermal camera sees heat, so a person in black water still glows on the screen.
The swimmer brought them out from beside the hull, one at a time.
Then the basket carried each one up into the helicopter.
The crew worked from late at night into the next morning.
outcome: All four reached Air Station Clearwater, and no injuries were reported.

location_card.place: South of St. George Island, Florida

title: Sailboat lost all power 44 miles out
description:
Late on Oct. 16, 2023, and into the next morning, a Coast Guard Air Station Clearwater MH-60 Jayhawk crew rescued four mariners after their 58-foot sailing vessel lost all power 44 miles south of St. George Island, Florida.
